name: Bottle Tycoon
desc:
✔️ Open your own bottle factory and start an empire! Rob other factories to become the ultimate tycoon! 💼💰
✔️ Manage your factory's cleanliness to avoid fines! Find out what mystery lies behind the 9th rebirth! 🔍💰
✔️ Collect dropped cash and fallen stars; Deliver boxes to speed up your progress! 🌟🚚

⚙️ You can host a private server for 100 Robux if you don't want to get robbed and avoid the health inspector. You also get a 1.5x money boost, which is stackable on other boosts! 🛡️💰

🌐 Join AtomicWeave Laboratories for these benefits! 💸
✔️ Additional $1,000 starting cash.
✔️ An exclusive and coloured chat tag.
✔️ A random item that randomizes every time you reset. 🎁🔄
